Together, we stand as A Force
for Good

At Texas A&M University, we develop leaders of character who take action and create lasting impact. Through educational excellence and world-class research, we are building a brighter, safer world for the people of Texas, the nation and beyond.

Learn How to Apply Request Information View Colleges & Schools Visit Texas A&M

Standing Together For Good

At Texas A&M University, we stand to be the best for the world. Since 1876, Aggies have answered the call to lead with character and serve with compassion — for Texas, the nation and beyond.

Our research drives solutions that matter: from disaster preparedness and agriculture to immersive technology, robotics, leadership and civics. Our students leave prepared to create anything possible — equipped with knowledge, shaped by values and committed to serving for the good of our communities.

This is what it means to be an Aggie: to stand together as a force for good.

More like this

Texas A&M AgriLife awarded USDA funding for New World screwworm research

Jun 30, 2026

AgriLife’s projects will focus on sterile fly production, product assessment and other efforts.

Bush Combat Development Complex fuels rapid defense innovation

Jun 25, 2026

The George H.W. Bush Combat Development Complex is accelerating research innovation and delivering advanced capabilities to the American warfighter while keeping the values of its namesake alive.

Scientists measure hidden quantum forces that could power a new generation of pharmaceutical drugs

Jun 25, 2026

Researchers invent a laser technique that reveals the hidden forces shaping proteins, advancing a future of precision medicine engineered with quantum precision.

Can virtual reality and AI help construction workers avoid accidents?

Jun 23, 2026

A Texas A&M researcher is studying whether immersive simulations can help prevent workers from becoming desensitized to jobsite hazards.

A healing patch that could accelerate heart attack recovery recognized as ‘World Changing Idea’

Fast Company recognized Texas A&M’s research on a heart patch that may offer a way to help heal the heart after a heart attack. The patch uses a unique microneedle system to deliver a therapeutic molecule directly to damaged heart tissue, promoting repair and improving heart function without affecting the rest of the body.

Campus Events

October 2, 2026
150th Opening Ceremony
4:00 p.m. - 5:00 p.m. • J.K. Williams Admin Building

Gather at the steps of the Jack K. Williams Administration Building for the official kickoff of the sesquicentennial celebration. The 150th anniversary of our university will be commemorated with an official proclamation and remarks by leadership, along with student performances celebrating Texas A&M’s rich history and traditions.

October 2, 2026
150th Celebration Kickoff at Kyle
9:00 p.m. • Kyle Field

Take part in a special Fightin’ Texas Aggie Yell Practice held at 9 p.m. in Kyle Field, followed by a one-of-a-kind drone show to kick off our sesquicentennial celebration.

Why Texas A&M?

At Texas A&M, you'll receive a premier education at an affordable price. But being an Aggie is about more than your time in classrooms. It’s about becoming a member of one of the friendliest university communities. It means leading with integrity. And it involves joining some of the loudest, proudest fans in the Southeastern Conference.

12 reasons to live and learn in Aggieland

Ready to Learn More?

If you're interested in becoming an Aggie, we want to hear from you and help you explore your interests. Sign up to receive admissions details, important announcements and special event invitations, and to learn more about life as an Aggie.
